::: {.obsidian-lecture-notes}
:::

State the lecture objectives in one paragraph. Name what the
student should know and be able to do by the end.

# Key points

Develop the key points in short sections. Use one sub heading per
point and one paragraph or list per sub heading.

# Examples

Work through one or two worked examples. Show the reasoning step by
step.

# Reading

List the required reading and the optional reading.

# Questions

List the questions for the tutorial and for self study.
